findings.description: The revised convention correctly distinguishes an absent tool from a present tool's named install failure, permits wording assertions only when output is the contract, and the stated stderr claim remains accurate because the remaining redirects are presence probes rather than reported install calls.
findings.evidence: Brief, “stderr handling and prose accuracy”: remaining `2>/dev/null` examples are probes such as `code --version 2>/dev/null`; Constitution B-2 requirement 5 applies to install calls whose failures are reported, and the brief states the dated decisionLog entry was added.

findings.description: All four clean-run outputs contain no failure summary, failure heading, zero-count, or failed-item line; complete silence from install-packages satisfies the requirement because it forbids failure output but does not require success output.
findings.evidence: Crossing evidence clean-run stdout: `run_onchange_install-packages.sh.tmpl` exits 0 with no output, while the other three outputs contain only successful progress/completion messages and no failure summary.

findings.description: The clean-run evidence shows no empty, bare, or headerless failure summary from any empty failure accumulator path.
findings.evidence: Crossing evidence clean-run stdout for all four converted scripts exits 0 and contains no blank failure heading, unnamed failure line, or empty failure summary.

findings.description: The complete bats suite terminates successfully with all tests passing, preserves or exceeds every pre-existing per-file test-count floor, and adds no skipped test line.
findings.evidence: Checker-of-record evidence: `timeout 300 bats tests/` exited 0 with `1..117`, 117 `ok` lines and no `not ok`; floors are met for apps 18/18, doctor 10/11, font 44/44, jsonc 9/9, licensed-fonts 7/7, and packages 13/13; skip grep returned no matches.

findings.description: The recorded working-tree changes are confined to the stated script, tests, and working-memory allowlist, with the macOS configuration script explicitly unchanged.
findings.evidence: Checker-of-record evidence: `check-diff-scope.py` reported `OK: 9 path(s) in scope` and listed only allowed paths; it additionally verified `run_once_after_configure-macos.sh` was untouched.
